instructions:
## Research objective

Improve tokenization so scientific material terms retain useful structure and downstream information-extraction performance increases.

## Work to perform

Use the supplied scientific-language-model setup and MatSci-NLP tasks. Source evaluation covers named-entity recognition, relation classification, event argument extraction, paragraph classification, synthesis action retrieval, sentence classification and slot filling. Compare against BPE, WordPiece, SAGE and PickyBPE using the same evaluation protocol.

Start from the supplied baseline repository, formulate an improvement, implement it, execute the experiments, and use observed results to refine the method. The benchmark withholds the original paper’s proposed solution.

## Deliverable

Tokenizer and model-training implementation plus saved artifacts required by the grading scripts.

## Evaluation

Micro-F1 and Macro-F1 across the source task datasets. Compare against the baseline values in the linked task brief. Evaluation datasets/conditions are component subtasks of this research environment, not separately provisioned workspaces.

## Resources

ResearchGym reports autonomous 12–24-hour runs and fixed API budgets. The README default API budget is $10; exact GPU model is not specified in this task brief.

This is a paraphrased reading guide. [Read the complete task instructions and baseline tables](https://github.com/Anikethh/ResearchGym/blob/main/tasks/test/materials-tokenization/task_description.md).
